meta.title: The Geography of NFL Talent
meta.methodology: Every official draft selection is joined by draft year and overall pick. A county is accepted from a verified high school first. When that county cannot be verified, historical birth fallback requires agreement across Wikidata and the exact English-Wikipedia/DBpedia record and one unambiguous Census county. The 2026 class uses no birth fallback. Fuzzy, nearest, centroid-only, and arbitrary multi-county assignments are rejected.
meta.conferenceDefinition: Conference means the NCAA general institutional affiliation for the academic year ending in the draft year, not a football-only conference. Unsupported or multiple affiliations are labeled Unknown. Conference labels are audited through 2025. All 257 selections from 2026 remain Unknown pending a draft-year NCAA membership audit; prior-year labels are not inferred. Exact-year 2026 conference filtering is disabled, and named-conference filters spanning 2026 exclude that class.
